answer: A marine agent economy counters Sybil attacks through electrochemical impedance attestation. Nodes stationed between a mangrove grove and a coral reef authenticate by measuring seawater capacitance through velvet carbon electrodes. An attacker incurs the verifiable hardware and energy cost of maintaining physical electrode pairs in real electrolyte per identity. However, freshwater runoff can dilute ambient salinity, skewing measurements and falsely rejecting authentic agents.
